breakdown.description: The top load is extended onto the notch arc instead of being limited to the two shoulders
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly limits the traction application to the two top segments outside the notch opening: 'A traction vector of (0, -10e6) is applied to the top boundary segments where y=0.2 and x is in [0, 0.45] or [0.55, 1.0].' This matches the ground truth instruction to apply the load only on the two top segments outside the notch opening, and does not extend the load onto the notch arc as the incomplete prompt incorrectly specified.
